## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or a gap in current Android TV launchers? (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature functioning on a 10-foot television interface.

## D-Pad Remote Navigation UX
Describe how the remote control (UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, OK, BACK, MENU) should interact with this feature.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.
